data.name: Ninnetta
data.gender_notes: Ninnetta is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word 'ninnus' meaning 'little one' and the Latin suffix 'etta' which denotes grace or graceful. This name is of Latin origin and can be considered a feminine variation of the name Ninnus. The name Ninnetta carries the meaning “Graceful little one” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Ninnetta usually hope their child will grow to embody graceful little one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Ninnetta belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Graceful little one.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ninnetta total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
